question: In which year was the Integrated Child Development Scheme (ICDS) launched in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Integrated Child Development Scheme (ICDS)** was launched in the year **1975**.
 
• ICDS is a government program in India that provides food, preschool education, and primary healthcare to children under 6 years of age and their mothers.
 
• The scheme aims to combat child hunger and malnutrition.
 
• ICDS services are provided through a network of Anganwadi centers established mainly in rural areas, urban slums, and tribal areas.
 
• It encompasses several components including supplementary nutrition, immunization, health check-ups, and referral services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ICDS is one of the world’s largest and most unique programs for early childhood care and development.
 
• The program is sponsored by the Indian government and is supported by state governments and UNICEF.
 
• ICDS has been instrumental in improving the health and nutritional status of children in India.
 
• The scheme also focuses on the health and education of mothers, thus promoting overall family welfare.
 
• Periodic evaluations and revisions of the scheme have been undertaken to ensure its effectiveness and relevance.
